ev.q: During September 1–November 20, 2023, the Blue Ridge Poison Center (BRPC) in Charlottesville, Virginia managed four cases of illness
Analysis of contents of five brands of mushroom gummies marketed as nootropics
All patients experienced tachycardia, confusion, anxiety or somnolence, and nausea
Two patients received benzodiazepines, three received antiemetics, and all four received intravenous fluids.
investigators purchased six packages (five different brands) during October at gas stations and smoke shops near BRPC for testing

methods_quotes.q: A qualitative untargeted approach was employed using independent data acquisition and substances identified using retention times, mass accuracy, and library matching.
The limit of detection for every compound in the library was not determined.
